description: Land Acquisition - Supplements 235 and 67 in Topo PP 13 of Miniranketiya, Laggala Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District - Amendments to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1899/5 of 26.01.2015 by Biyagama D/S Division and No. 1923/68 of 17.07.2015 Gangawata Kotale  D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing government acquisition of various land parcels for the Moragahakanda & Kaluganga Development Project. It includes detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and purposes, along with procedures for claimants to seek compensation. This fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land acquisition and property matters.
